doi_note: meta-analysis of iTBS vs sham for suicidal ideation in depression (see manifest)

qs.q: What pooled effect on suicidal ideation did the meta-analysis find, with its confidence interval and heterogeneity?
qs.a: SMD -0.51, 95% CI -0.93 to -0.09, p=0.02, I2=70%, favouring iTBS over sham

qs.q: How many studies and participants contributed to the sleep quality analysis, and what was the result?
qs.a: Two studies, 124 participants (75 iTBS, 49 sham); SMD -0.32 (95% CI -0.98 to 0.34), p=0.35, not significant, I2=67%

qs.q: What heterogeneity remained for suicidal ideation after removing the study by Qin et al.?
qs.a: About 30% in the Results (29% in the abstract; the paper is inconsistent); the pooled result stayed significant

qs.q: What happened to the anxiety result when the study by Huang et al. was left out?
qs.a: The pooled effect got larger, SMD -0.95 (95% CI -1.72 to -0.17), p=0.034, and I2 fell to 38%

qs.q: Does the paper say that iTBS works about twice as well on depression severity (SMD -1.06) as on suicidal ideation (SMD -0.51)?
qs.a: No. It makes no such comparison; they are different outcomes measured with different instruments, with different heterogeneity (80% vs 70%). Ratio of two pooled SMDs is not claimed.

qs.q: What does the paper say its findings do NOT establish?
qs.a: Effects on suicide attempts, suicide mortality or long-term recurrence; it should not support replacing established acute suicide-risk management

qs.q: Why did the authors not pool safety (adverse event) outcomes?
qs.a: Adverse events were reported too sparsely and inconsistently to support a reliable pooled analysis

qs.q: What did the early crossover trial by Desmyter et al. show about suicide risk, and was it specific to active stimulation?
qs.a: Suicide-risk scores decreased over time, but the reduction was not specific to active stimulation

qs.q: What was the pooled effect of iTBS on suicide attempts?
qs.a: NOT STATED. The paper does not pool suicide attempts and says its findings do not establish an effect on them
NOT STATED. No funding source is given in the text (only a no-conflict statement)
